name: custom-commands
title: Custom Commands
description: Create and run your own custom shell commands directly from Vicinae. Define commands with arguments, run in terminal or background.
author: OmerMohideen

commands.name: commands
commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Create and run your custom shell commands

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal command to run commands that require a terminal (e.g. kitty, gnome-terminal --). Leave empty to use Vicinae default.

preferences.name: defaultWorkdir
preferences.title: Default Working Directory
preferences.description: Default directory for commands without a custom working directory. Leave empty for home directory.
